announcements.title: Parenting Seminar
announcements.description:
Saturday, November 7 from 9–11:30am | CPC Fellowship Hall | Light Breakfast | Childcare provided.

We’re hoping for helpful cross-pollination among all stages of parenting. There will be time for discussion, collaboration, and prayer.

For all parents and children that are planning to attend, please RSVP here.

announcements.title: Interested in Joining the Body of Christ at CPC?
announcements.description:
We consider the church an essential element of the gospel, so joining CPC as a member is a way to truly join the body of Christ, in all its blessings and with all its flaws! Before joining, you’ll meet one-on-one with a pastor and then discuss how you’ve come to know Christ with the Shepherd Leaders. Email admin@cpcnewhaven.org to begin the process.

Our next joining will take place on Sunday, November 15.

announcements.title: Thanksgiving Fellowship Meals
announcements.description:
Sign Up Here as Host or Guest

Staying local for Thanksgiving? Come celebrate with your brothers and sisters in Christ! As we’ve done in the past, we’re coordinating hosts & guests to have a Thanksgiving meal together on November 26. If you're interested, please email admin@cpcnewhaven.org or fill out the form.

announcements.title: Hill Christmas Store | Donate by December 6
announcements.description:
Donate by Sunday, December 6, 2026

Please join us in our 13th annual Hill Christmas Store! We will be sharing Christmas joy with some wonderful families from New Haven’s Hill community. Purchase and leave an unwrapped gift valued at $20 or more for a child in the designated category (e.g., “Girl, 9–14”). In the spirit of empowerment, your gift will in turn be bought at a very reduced price by families in the Hill at the store.

Please reach out to Kaitlyn Jessee (kaijessee@gmail.com) with any questions.
